name: Push / pull / legs
notes: This advanced plan groups muscles by how they move. Push works chest, shoulders, and triceps. Pull works back and biceps. Legs works quads, hamstrings, and calves. The 3-day cycle repeats so you train 6 days, then rest on Sunday. Weights are starting placeholders.

activities.name: Push
activities.instructions: Chest, shoulders, and triceps. Rest about 2 minutes between sets.

exercises.name: Chest press
exercises.instructions: Lower with control, then press without locking the elbows hard.
exercises.notes: Dumbbell floor press is fine at home.

exercises.name: Shoulder press
exercises.instructions: Brace, press up, and do not over-arch the lower back.

exercises.name: Tricep extension
exercises.instructions: Keep the elbows still. Lower, then extend without locking hard.

activities.name: Pull
activities.instructions: Back and biceps. Rest about 2 minutes between sets.

exercises.name: Bent-over row
exercises.instructions: Hinge, keep the torso still, and pull the elbows toward the hips.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.instructions: Pull the bar to the upper chest. Do not lean too far back.
exercises.notes: One-arm dumbbell rows if you have no cable.

exercises.name: Bicep curl
exercises.instructions: Elbows by the ribs. Lower under control.

activities.name: Legs
activities.instructions: Quads, hamstrings, and calves. Rest about 2 minutes between sets.

exercises.name: Squat
exercises.instructions: Sit between the hips, keep the chest up, then stand tall.
exercises.notes: Goblet squat if you train with dumbbells.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Hinge, keep the weight close, and stand tall without shrugging.
exercises.notes: Romanian deadlift with dumbbells is a good home option.

exercises.name: Calf raise
exercises.instructions: Rise onto the toes, pause, then lower through a full stretch.
